notes:
Live Observation (optional, default OFF)

- Google ID link karke startup crash, video/AV sync, cache aur update problems admin tak bhej sakte hain.
- File names, folder paths, media titles, search queries, emails aur tokens kabhi nahi bhejte.
- Kabhi bhi OFF, unlink ya delete kar sakte hain. Raw logs 90 din ke baad delete.

In-app update fix

- Ab purane version se seedha newest version ka update card aata hai.
- Naya version publish hone par purana card turant replace ho jaata hai.
- Purani release ki downloaded APK install nahi hoti.
